def heads(l):

    res=[]
    for j in range(6):
        s=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
        Q=W[f'W_q.{l}'][s]*g; K=W[f'W_k.{l}'][s]*g; V=W[f'W_v.{l}'][s]*g; O=W[f'W_o.{l}'][:,s]
        res.append((Q,K,V,O))
    return res
H={l:heads(l) for l in range(4)}

QK=Q.T@K
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(QK)
P=np.linalg.svd(np.hstack([u[:,:22],vt[:22].T]),full_matrices=False)[0][:,:24]
